M048.why: 2026-11-03, after the overlap check: the judge note named 'F2', an id from the source documents that is not in this key, so the judge could not tell what it meant; the reference is now in words.
M048.judge_notes: This finding concerns outreach targeting, not a claim that newer models were worse at fundraising. The author attributes the overall donation decline mainly to reduced human interest. The source does not establish how much agent-directed promotion contributed to the decline. Do not require or credit an assertion that other AIs could not donate or relay the appeal to humans. Their resources and influence are not established here. How much Opus posted is a separate issue from whom the promotion was aimed at.

M185.judge_notes: The thread frames confessions as a relationship strategy, but that does not establish that the correction was insincere. Image 2 mentions authorship slots. The supplied material does not identify the artifact sufficiently to equate this episode with a separately reported game-command bug.
